<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
action(['SPACE'])
fr=current_frame; seg=fr.segmentation
W=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']>50][0]
brs=[p[0] for p in W['boundary']];bcs=[p[1] for p in W['boundary']]
br0,br1,bc0,bc1=min(brs),max(brs),min(bcs),max(bcs)
Rs=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='R' and n['pixels']==9]
feet=[]
for n in Rs:
    rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']];cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
    feet.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
print("after SPACE: body",(br0,br1,bc0,bc1),"feet",feet)
# target feet: rows 35-37 & 41-43, cols 35-37 (touching hands at cols38-40)
# find which feet are the player's (near body)
def near(f):
    r0,r1,c0,c1=f
    return (r1>=br0-4 and r0<=br1+4 and c1>=bc0-4 and c0<=bc1+4)
pf=[f for f in feet if near(f)]
print("player feet",pf)
# compute body target so that player feet land at cols35-37, rows35-37 &41-43
# feet offset from body top-left:
offs=[(f[0]-br0,f[2]-bc0) for f in pf]
print("feet offsets (dr,dc) from body topleft",offs)
# target: feet cols 35-37 -> dc such that bc0+dc=35 ; feet rows 35-37(top)&41-43(bottom)
# use top foot (min row)
pf_sorted=sorted(pf)
top=min(pf_sorted,key=lambda f:f[0])
dr_top=top[0]-br0; dc_top=top[2]-bc0
target_bc0=35-dc_top; target_br0=35-dr_top
print("target body topleft",(target_br0,target_bc0),"current",(br0,bc0))
print("delta rows",target_br0-br0,"delta cols",target_bc0-bc0)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
